title: The Shaukeens
desc: Bored of their mundane lives, three 60-something men, immersed in the allure of Mauritius, rekindle their youthful spirits and compete for the attention of a vivacious social media addict, Ahana.

title: The Dirty Picture
desc: A biographical drama film inspired by the life of South Indian actress Silk Smitha. The movie follows the journey of a young woman, who dreams of becoming a film star. It depicts her rise to fame in the film industry and politics, her turbulent personal life, and the challenges she faces as a woman in a male-dominated industry.

title: Omerta
desc: Omerta (2018) is a gripping biographical thriller about Ahmed Omar Saeed Sheikh, a British-born terrorist involved in kidnappings and the murder of journalist Daniel Pearl.

title: Zameer The Fire Within
desc: A spoiled brat gets married to her professor despite several challenges. Soon after, he learns that his wife was responsible for the separation of his ex-girlfriend and he leaves her, never to return.
